name: "Snide" Owen
biography: "Snide" Owen has worked in various IT fields from tech support to development. Combining that knowledge he moved into the security field by way of Application Security and is now on an offensive security research team. He enjoys both making and breaking, tinkering with various technologies, and has experimented for prolonged periods with PBX's and the obscure side of VoIP.
